title: Introduction to Internet of Things
description: This course explores Internet of Things (IoT) technologies with emphasis on manufacturing applications. Students learn about Industrial Internet of Things, Cloud Computing, and Smart Data.
outcomes: Identify applications of the Internet of Things (IoT).
Understand the concept of the Internet of Things (IoT) and its relationship with Cloud Computing and Smart Data.
Design an IoT based system, component, or process to meet desired needs within realistic constraints, such as manufacturability and sustainability, that translates into high productivity
Use the techniques, skills, and modern engineering tools necessary for engineering practice to construct an IoT based system, component, or process.
content: Cyber Security Risks and Web applications relevant to IoT devices
lab: Cyber Security Risks and Web applications relevant to IoT devices
assignments: Scholarly journals and industry materials as chosen by instructor
Students are required to design and build IoT systems to meet specified
requirements. Example: Design and Build an IoT System that monitors and
controls temperature and humidity in a green house.
Students write technical reports on relevant IoT systems. Example: Write a
technical report (using the report writing template provided by the instructor) on
Industrial IoT and its relevance in the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
Students write lab reports and make entries in lab notebooks detailing
experiments, design and construction work completed during lab sessions.
Example: Write a Lab report for the Temperature Sensor experiment.
